name: ssas
description: SSAS — Smart Schedule & Accountability System. This package.json covers only the server-side automation scripts (server-*.js): reminder engine, accountability engine, Telegram bot, email, Google OAuth exchange — all run as free GitHub Actions scheduled jobs, never as billed Cloud Functions. The frontend PWA (app-*.js, index.html) is plain ES modules with no build step and no dependency on this package.json.
